# PM Enterprises

> Industrial & urban fire protection company based in Simurali, Nadia, West Bengal, India (founded 2023). PM Enterprises supplies and installs fire hydrants, extinguishers, alarms, sprinklers and detection systems, and provides installation, maintenance and fire-safety compliance audits across all of West Bengal.

## Product categories
- Landing valves (Type-A/Type-B), collecting heads, water monitors, shut-off & branch-pipe nozzles
- Hydrant accessories: delivery hose couplings, hose boxes, hose reel drums, sprinklers
- Fire alarms: manual call points, fire alarm panels, M.S. hooters, smoke detectors, strobe alarms
- Fire extinguishers: ABC dry powder, CO2 (4.5–22.5 kg), AFFF foam (9–50 L), DCP (5–25 kg), water CO2, automatic modular and portable units

## Notes
- Service area: all of West Bengal, India.
- Equipment standards referenced: IS / ISI, UL, FM, CE, EN-54, ISO 9001.
- Founded 2023; focus on quality assurance, reliable after-sales service and code-compliant installations.
